summary: Daedalus is an authenticated local-development workspace in which a Next.js client and local daemon coordinate through Supabase. The daemon discovers feature and parameter files, supervises feature processes and agent worktrees, records durable outcomes, and generates validated Architecture Views; the client presents those states with ventures and operational controls.

systems.name: Supabase Communication and Review Protocol
systems.summary: User-scoped Supabase tables, RPCs, row-level policies, and recipient-review states provide the durable coordination plane for browser, daemon, and daemon-manager work while bounding recurrent payload transfer.

systems.name: Workspace Discovery and Feature Graph
systems.summary: The local daemon scans canonical project feature and parameter files, and the workspace renders feature-only graph navigation with paired parameter editing and project-qualified feature selection.

systems.name: Agent Prompt Chat
systems.summary: The Edit surface composes and submits standard, planning, and ask prompts with model, reasoning, project, and feature targeting; it delegates status, response, and archive presentation to the output viewer.

systems.name: Daedalus Git Worktrees
systems.summary: A durable daemon orchestrator admits standard agent tasks into isolated Git worktrees, runs repair and verification loops, coordinates task cohorts and integration branches, and promotes only verified local main-line results.

systems.name: Supabase Migration Deployment
systems.summary: For a verified integration batch, the daemon validates canonical migration files and, when explicitly enabled and allowlisted, serializes Supabase CLI preflight and deployment with redacted diagnostics and recovery-aware blocking behavior.

systems.name: Feature Execution System
systems.summary: The daemon validates a feature-owned Python entry point, supervises its process asynchronously, captures bounded diagnostics, and persists independently cancellable execution-run lifecycle state.

systems.name: Git Sync
systems.summary: The workspace submits explicit commit, sync, and status requests for a selected repository, and the local daemon executes fixed Git command arrays and returns requested status or failure diagnostics through the coordination plane.

systems.name: Local Daemon Manager
systems.summary: A lease-backed supervisor owns the execution daemon process lifecycle, admission gating, restart draining, crash recovery, and health publication for a user-scoped local execution layer.

systems.name: Agent Output Viewer
systems.summary: The authenticated history workspace merges active prompt and task state with durable per-prompt archive records, keeping implementation output, planning exchanges, terminal errors, retries, and blocked integration batches distinct.

systems.name: System Architecture Communication Engine
systems.summary: The daemon creates task-scoped Architecture View requests from immutable task commit boundaries, feature-file ownership candidates, and Graphify evidence, then manages generation-scoped progress and persistence handoff.

systems.name: System Architecture Visualization Engine
systems.summary: A strict versioned architecture-document contract validates normalized system and channel data, and the workspace deterministically lays it out as an SVG diagram with current-generation progress states.

systems.name: Ventures
systems.summary: The workspace provides an authenticated drawer for user-owned venture records, including progress, project and feature-file tags, optional details, and guarded clearing of completed entries.
